body: RaKai walked away when Tota tried asking him how he felt about Reggie calling him “famous hungry” The tense moment comes shortly after Reggie accused RaKai of being fake and claimed that he only cares about going viral. So when Tota brought up Reggie’s “famous hungry” comment, it seemed to touch on a much bigger issue between the two. Instead of explaining how the comment made him feel, RaKai appeared visibly upset and chose to walk away from the conversation.
